summary: The document contains a JavaScript hack to ensure modal popups and potentially other Ajax Toolkit elements function correctly in WebKit-based browsers such as Safari 3 and Chrome.
purpose: To implement compatibility between Ajax Toolkit features and WebKit-based browsers by identifying the WebKit user agent and adjusting the browser detection logic in JavaScript.

workflows.name: Apply WebKit Compatibility Hack
steps: Identify if the user agent string contains 'WebKit/'.
Set Sys.Browser.agent to Sys.Browser.WebKit if the condition is true.
Extract the version of WebKit from the user agent string and assign it to Sys.Browser.version.

system_behavior: Modifies the Sys.Browser object properties based on the user agent string to ensure compatibility with WebKit-based browsers.
